notes.content:
Today and tomorrow we are going to upload more cards and enlarge Project Noah System. 
This prepares the DeepSpace mode we work on it with several planets and races.
Besides this fight system gets five more units: 1 human, 2 zombie and 2 alien units.

notes.title: UPDATE:
notes.content:
Hi,
We have made some improvements like
 - now you can select multiple battle units with the same type by clicking on it twice
 - zombies will attack less often and only once per turn
 - loading time is much faster
 - fixed a bug, where you could not reject a battle
